Founded in 2003 by Dong Hyun Kim, his mission was simple, to make fresh and flavorsome sushi and bento available to everyone.
  
  
Almost 20 years later Wasabi have 39 successful branches across London, other UK major cities and 4 in New York.
  
  
The journey continued in 2019 with the launch of Wasabi Home Bento exclusively into Sainsburys. After several years of great success there, the grocery business expanded launching into Tesco in September 2022. Wasabi has now firmly established itself as the No2 chilled ready meal brand and a driver of significant market growth. And we’re just getting started. The leadership team have set out their 5 year strategy which encompasses company growth, franchise and international expansion.
  
  
Our menu is renowned for its distinctiveness, freshness and flavour. The cold food range of sushi, pokes and salads are made fresh daily in our branch kitchens and our hot bento, noodle bowls and soups offer an indulgent and comforting alternative to our broad and democratic demographic.
  
  
As we prepare for our next phase of growth and innovation, we have an incredibly exciting opportunity for a
**Shopper Marketing Manager**
to join our Marketing Team based in Park Royal.

This newly created role offers an exciting opportunity to shape how Wasabi shows up in grocery and connects with shoppers. Combining creative thinking with commercial know-how, you’ll build strong retailer partnerships, engage shoppers and deliver marketing that strengthens our brand and drives sales.

Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

**The Team**

The Netflix Brand Creative Studio collaborates with external brands and agency/production partners as well as internal cross-functional teams to create compelling campaigns, activations, sponsorships, and other innovative solutions. The studio consists of 5 disciplines: Brand Strategy, Creative, Production, Design and Social - collectively tasked with ensuring all work has a clear and compelling strategy, crafted at the highest quality, and executed flawlessly. You will be joining an established (& growing) Strategy function, responsible for bringing rigor, clarity and focus to the challenges brought to the Brand Creative Studio.

  
  

This role will chiefly support the EMEA Ads Marketing team, which is responsible for shaping how our core Netflix Ads positioning is activated and executed across the region, through compelling, differentiated narratives and activations. By activating these messages across both sales channels (presentations, materials, talking points, events) and broader non-sales channels, the team builds widespread awareness and excitement among our key advertising partners. Our calendar is a mixture of owned moments (eg. Netflix Upfronts), impactful presence at industry events (eg. Cannes Lions, OMR) and content published via our scaled channels (eg. Website, LinkedIn).

  
  

**About The Role**

We are seeking a seasoned strategist with deep experience in brand strategy for ads marketing. The ideal candidate is passionate about building brands that shape culture, combining creative ambition with strategic discipline to generate impactful outcomes.

  
  

Working closely with the EMEA Ads Marketing team this role will focus on building a premium B2B Netflix Ads brand that feels fundamentally different from the rest of the market. The right candidate will apply Netflix’s storytelling and entertainment DNA to a differentiated Ads business that feels premium, modern and unmistakably Netflix. At Franco Manca, great pizza starts with great people and a brand that has always done things a little differently.

We’re the sourdough pizza pioneers who first brought our pizza to Brixton. Since then, we’ve grown into a well-loved restaurant brand with neighbourhood restaurants across the UK. Now, we’re entering an exciting stage of transformation and growth.

We’re looking for a talented, creative and commercially minded **Marketing Manager** to help shape the next chapter of Franco Manca.

You’ll take ownership of our marketing calendar and lead the delivery of campaigns that build brand awareness, bring more guests into our restaurants and support commercial growth. From national brand campaigns and local restaurant marketing to CRM, PR and in-restaurant materials, you’ll make sure everything lands on time, on budget and with real impact.

You’ll work closely with our Digital and Social Marketing team, restaurant teams and wider support functions. This is a hybrid role based from our Soho office, with regular visits to our restaurants to stay close to our teams, guests and the communities we serve.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a well-known brand with plenty of personality, where you’ll have the freedom to bring new ideas, challenge expectations and make a genuine impact.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Developing and delivering marketing strategies that increase brand awareness, consideration and revenue growth.
* Taking ownership of the marketing calendar and making sure campaigns and initiatives are delivered on time, within budget and with impact.
* Leading the delivery of brand campaigns, local restaurant marketing initiatives and point-of-sale materials.
* Working closely with the Digital and Social Marketing team to make sure every channel is working together effectively.
* Acting as a brand guardian across all customer touchpoints and communications, including in-restaurant materials, CRM and PR.
* Protecting the core personality of Franco Manca while finding creative and unexpected ways to bring the brand to life.
* Taking ownership of the commercial targets linked to campaigns, measuring performance and sharing clear results with the wider business.
* Identifying opportunities to improve campaigns and maximise their commercial impact.
* Building strong and collaborative relationships with Operations, Procurement, Finance and other support teams.
* Supporting our restaurant teams with practical local marketing ideas that help them connect with their communities and grow sales.
* Keeping up to date with changing guest behaviour, hospitality trends and activity across the wider market.

**We’re looking for someone who**

* Has experience working as a Marketing Manager in a multi-site hospitality, retail or QSR business.
* Has strong brand-building experience and knows how to balance creativity with consistency.
* Is commercially minded and understands how marketing can support both short-term performance and long-term brand growth.
* Enjoys trying new ideas, pushing creative boundaries and finding unexpected ways to engage customers.
* Is highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage several projects at the same time.
* Can turn ideas into action and has a proven track record of delivering results quickly and effectively.
* Builds strong working relationships and communicates confidently with people across different areas of a business.
* Is comfortable using campaign performance and commercial information to guide decisions.
* Has a genuine passion for food, restaurants and the hospitality industry.
* Wants to play an important part in shaping the future of Franco Manca.

**Why Franco Manca?**

We’re proud of where we’ve come from and excited about where we’re going.

This is an opportunity to join a recognised restaurant brand at an important point in its journey. You’ll have the chance to shape how we communicate with our guests, support our restaurants and bring the Franco Manca personality to life across every channel.

You’ll be joining a friendly, ambitious team where good ideas are welcomed, collaboration matters and you can see the impact of your work in our restaurants.

If this sounds like the kind of role where you could do your best work, we’d love to hear from you.

We welcome applications from everyone and recruit based on skills, experience and potential. If you need any adjustments during the application or interview process, please let us know and we’ll be happy to support you.*

You will write for three readers: enterprise CX leaders choosing a voice AI partner, developers building agents on our platform and APIs, and the technical audience that follows our models and research.

Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews which voice AI vendors to evaluate, often before they visit a vendor's website. Your job is to get PolyAI into those answers with an accurate description, then turn the visits that follow into sign-ups and sales conversations.

This role suits a writer who builds. You will use Claude Code, AI skills, Git repos and our CMS to turn one strong brief into dozens of strong pages, and you will have the editorial judgment to hold back a page that isn't ready. You won't start from zero: we already have early skills for use-case pages and content review, and a backlog of drafts waiting for an editor.
